t: 第一个不仅包括领主,而且包括各大城镇代表的英国议会在威斯敏斯特宫举行第一次会议,现在俗称"议会…
te: The first English parliament to include not only Lords but also representatives of the major towns holds its first meet…
dz: 第一个不仅包括领主,而且包括各大城镇代表的英国议会在威斯敏斯特宫举行第一次会议,现在俗称"议会之家".
de: The first English parliament to include not only Lords but also representatives of the major towns holds its first meeting in the Palace of Westminster, now commonly known as the "Houses of Parliament".

t: 教宗克莱门特四世被选为罗马第183任主教并担任天主教会会长.
te: Pope Clement IV is elected as the 183rd Bishop of Rome and head of the Catholic Church.
dz: 教宗克莱门特四世被选为罗马第183任主教并担任天主教会会长.
de: Pope Clement IV is elected as the 183rd Bishop of Rome and head of the Catholic Church.

t: 威尼斯使节与皇帝迈克尔八世·帕拉伊洛戈斯(英语:Michael VIII Palaiologo…
te: A draft Byzantine–Venetian treaty is concluded between Venetian envoys and Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos, but is not…
dz: 威尼斯使节与皇帝迈克尔八世·帕拉伊洛戈斯(英语:Michael VIII Palaiologos)缔结拜占庭-威尼斯条约草案,但未获多吉·雷涅罗·泽诺批准.
de: A draft Byzantine–Venetian treaty is concluded between Venetian envoys and Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos, but is not ratified by Doge Reniero Zeno.

te: Battle of Evesham: The army of Prince Edward (the future king Edward I of England) defeats the forces of rebellious bar…
dz: 第二次男爵之战:埃夫沙姆之战:爱德华王子的军队(未来的英格兰国王爱德华一世)击败了西蒙·德·蒙特福特所率领的叛逆男爵(英语:Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester),杀死了德·蒙特福特和他的许多盟友.
de: Second Barons' War: Battle of Evesham: The army of Prince Edward (the future king Edward I of England) defeats the forces of rebellious barons led by Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester, killing de Montfort and many of his allies.
